    Allowed pairs and closed words (before Lemma 4.6) #

    A composable pair of letters is allowed if it is a pair of direct arrows ab with ab ∉ I, a pair of inverse arrows a⁻¹b⁻¹ with ba ∉ I, or a mixed pair ab⁻¹, a⁻¹b with a ≠ b. A closed word all of whose cyclic adjacent pairs are allowed yields bands, so representation-infinitude (not_isRepFinite_of_closed, part of Theorem 4.5; proved in Classification/ClosedBand.lean).

    Here: adjacent pairs of a string are allowed (chain_allowed), inverse words (invLetters), and the vanishing of the square of a loop and of two-cycles with both pairs allowed in a gentle algebra (equation (4.l)).
